Bhairava.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: गङ्गाधरः शशिकलातिलकस्त्रिनेत्रो भस्माङ्गरागरुचिरः सितकण्ठहारः। कैलासशैलशिखरे स्थित आत्मसंस्थो रागोऽयमुत्तमपदाभिधभैरवाख्यः॥
Bhairava.dhyana_verse_translation: Bearing the celestial Ganga, adorned with the crescent moon on his brow, three-eyed, smeared with white ash, wearing a shining garland on his fair throat, seated self-contained on the peak of Mount Kailash—such is the supreme Raga Bhairava.
key_iconographic_motifs: Lord Shiva seated on tiger skin or lotus pedestal
Trident (trishula) and damaru drum held in hands
Nandi the bull reclining beside him
Crescent moon on forehead and serpent around neck
Ascetic devotees offering bilva leaves or burning camphor
Mount Kailash rocky mountainous backdrop with sacred river

Bhairavi.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: स्फटिकरचितपीठे मन्दिरे सारसाक्षी कमलदलसमानैः पाणिभिः पूजयन्ती। हरमचलनिवासं तालनादप्रवीणा भवति समयभावा भैरवी रागिणी सा॥
Bhairavi.dhyana_verse_translation: Seated on a crystal throne within a lake pavilion, lotus-eyed, worshipping Lord Shiva with hands delicate as lotus petals, adept at rhythmic cymbals—such is Ragini Bhairavi.
key_iconographic_motifs: Solitary young heroine (nayika) worshipping a Shiva lingam
Offering of bilva leaves, lotus flowers, and incense before a shrine
Playing small brass cymbals (manjira) or resting hands reverently
Lake filled with blooming lotuses in front of marble shrine
Pair of attendant maidens bearing ritual trays

Malkaus.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: असिचर्मधरः शूरो रक्तवस्त्रविभूषणः। मालवश्रीसमायुक्तो मालकौशः प्रकीर्तितः॥
Malkaus.dhyana_verse_translation: Bearing a gleaming sword and shield, heroic, adorned in crimson red garments, accompanied by maidens offering betel—such is proclaimed the noble Raga Malkaus.
key_iconographic_motifs: Noble prince or hero seated in regal pavilion or palace terrace at night
Holding a sword, golden staff, or flower while gazing at his beloved
Night sky studded with stars or sliver of crescent moon
Attendant maidens holding golden chauri (flywhisk) and betel boxes
Musicians playing bin or rabab in attendance

Hindol.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: कन्दर्पदर्पदमनेन समाभिरामा दोलाधिरूढतनुरायतनेत्रपद्मा। सङ्गीतकौतुकपरायणमञ्जुवाचा हिन्दोलराग इति सम्परिकथ्यतेऽसौ॥
Hindol.dhyana_verse_translation: Outshining the pride of Kamadeva in beauty, seated on a golden flower-decked swing, wide-eyed like blooming lotuses, singing sweet melodies with charming maidens—such is known as Raga Hindol.
key_iconographic_motifs: Lord Krishna or romantic hero seated upon a decorated swing (hindola)
Swing suspended from flowering Kadamba, mango, or Asoka trees
Gopis and maidens pushing the ropes decorated with jasmine garlands
Maidens playing flutes, mridangam drums, and singing festive spring songs
Yellow flower carpets, blooming spring foliage, splashing colors

Deepak.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: प्रदीप्तदीपावलिशोभिताङ्गो विलोलनेत्रः शशिसूर्यतेजाः। प्रियासहायो निशि दीपकोऽयं दीपान् स्वयं प्रज्वलयन् विभाति॥
Deepak.dhyana_verse_translation: Adorned with rows of radiant oil lamps, restless-eyed, glowing with the luminescence of sun and fire, accompanied by his beloved at night, kindling flames by his melody alone—such is the brilliant Deepak Raga.
key_iconographic_motifs: Hero wearing a crown of radiant flames or holding a burning torch/lamp
Intimate palace chamber illuminated by rows of ornate brass oil lamps (diyas)
Lovers embracing on an ornate bed under an illuminated canopy
Candlesticks burning brightly throughout the courtyard
Flames symbolically bursting forth from torches or candles

Megha.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: नीलाम्बुदोत्तुङ्गनिकायशोभो विद्याधरोद्गीतयशोभिरामः। मत्तद्विपः पीतसुवस्त्रधारी मेघाह्वयो रागवरः प्रदिष्टः॥
Megha.dhyana_verse_translation: Splendid as dark towering rain clouds, celebrated in glorious songs by celestial musicians, riding an intoxicated elephant, clothed in brilliant yellow robes—such is declared the supreme Raga Megha.
key_iconographic_motifs: Dark swirling monsoon clouds (ghana) with zig-zag golden lightning
Flying cranes (sarasa) forming a white arc against the storm sky
Peacocks dancing on rooftops and trees with tails fanned out
Krishna or hero holding a bow or flower sceptre, listening to the thunder
Lush green meadows revived by raindrops

Sri.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: अष्टादशाब्दः सुरसुन्दरीभिः संसेव्यमानो मधुराभिलाषी। कर्णे दधानः कलकण्ठपक्षं श्रीराग एष क्षितिपप्रवीरः॥
Sri.dhyana_verse_translation: A youthful prince of eighteen years, attended by celestial beauties, yearning for sweet melodies, with the feather of a songbird tucked behind his ear—such is Raga Sri, the royal champion.
key_iconographic_motifs: Noble king seated on an elevated golden throne on an open terrace at sunset
Court musician kneeling before the king playing a Saraswati veena or rudra veena
Attendants holding peacock feather fans and royal parasol (chhatra)
Glowing sunset horizon with orange-red hues
Formal palace balustrade with fountains and flowerbeds

Todi.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: तुषारकुन्दोज्ज्वलदेहवल्ली काश्मीरकर्पूरविलेपिताङ्गी। विनोदयन्ती हरिणं वनान्ते वीणाधरा राजति तोडिकेयम्॥
Todi.dhyana_verse_translation: Her slender form radiant as frost and white jasmine, her limbs anointed with saffron and camphor, charming wild deer in the heart of the forest as she plucks her veena—such reigns the enchanting Ragini Todi.
key_iconographic_motifs: Young solitary nayika standing or seated in a wild, rocky landscape
Holding and playing a stringed rudra veena or tambura
Wild blackbucks and spotted deer gathered peacefully around her, enchanted by her song
One deer eating grass or nuzzling close to her hand
Flowering trees, rocks, and a stream flowing nearby

Asavari.dhyana_verse_sanskrit: मलयद्रुमशिखरे मणिविभूषिता सर्पवेष्टिताङ्गी। आसक्ता विरहिणी सा विन्ध्यतटे वसति आसारी रागिणी॥
Asavari.dhyana_verse_translation: Seated on the rocky crag of the Malaya sandal mountain, adorned with forest ornaments, venomous serpents coiled harmlessly about her limbs, an anguished lover separated from her lord—such is Ragini Asavari on the Vindhya slopes.
key_iconographic_motifs: Dark-complexioned yogini or tribal maiden wearing peacock feather skirt or bark garments
Seated atop a high rock or under a sandalwood tree
Multiple cobras and serpents entwined around her body, arms, and surrounding boulders
The serpents are docile, charmed by her sorrowful presence
Craggy mountain landscape with streams below
